name: secform4
what_it_holds: Python scripts (sec_filings.py, sec_analyst.py, all_companies.py) to track all SEC Form 4 insider-trading filings across companies and "investigate insider sentiment quicker". 8 commits, no license specified.
why_useful: Cross-company Form 4 puller could be pointed at ABNB and peers (BKNG, EXPE) to build an insider-sentiment time series; addresses gap #15.
themes: 13F holdings parsers and institutional-ownership history, short-interest datasets, insider-transaction parsers (Form 4), ETF holdings trackers
why_all: Cross-company Form 4 puller could be pointed at ABNB and peers (BKNG, EXPE) to build an insider-sentiment time series; addresses gap #15.

name: 13f_info_get_fund_holdings
what_it_holds: BeautifulSoup scraper of 13f.info for historical holdings of specific fund managers (Berkshire Hathaway, Bridgewater, Pershing Square, etc.). CC0-1.0 license (public domain), 1 star, updated 2025-03-03.
why_useful: A route to specific well-known funds' historical ABNB position sizes (if held) via 13f.info rather than raw EDGAR XML; CC0 license means output is freely reusable.
themes: 13F holdings parsers and institutional-ownership history, short-interest datasets, insider-transaction parsers (Form 4), ETF holdings trackers
why_all: A route to specific well-known funds' historical ABNB position sizes (if held) via 13f.info rather than raw EDGAR XML; CC0 license means output is freely reusable.

name: swift-edgar
what_it_holds: Native Swift, zero-dependency, async/await client for SEC EDGAR covering 13F filings, XBRL financials, insider trading (Form 4), fund holdings, and company search. MIT license, 1 star, updated 2026-07-12.
why_useful: Alternative-language (Swift) EDGAR client bundling 13F + Form 4 + fund holdings in one API; low practical value for a Python-based pipeline but confirms the method space is active and well-covered.
themes: 13F holdings parsers and institutional-ownership history, short-interest datasets, insider-transaction parsers (Form 4), ETF holdings trackers
why_all: Alternative-language (Swift) EDGAR client bundling 13F + Form 4 + fund holdings in one API; low practical value for a Python-based pipeline but confirms the method space is active and well-covered.

name: trade-copier-13f
what_it_holds: Pulls a chosen filer's SEC EDGAR 13F holdings, diffs consecutive quarters, and dry-runs proportional "mirror" trades on Alpaca paper trading (risk-gated); explicitly notes the 45-day disclosure lag and includes an honest backtest vs SPY. Updated 2026-09-03.
why_useful: Illustrates the quarter-over-quarter diff mechanics for a single filer's 13F holdings (useful pattern for building an ABNB-holder concentration/turnover series) and is refreshingly explicit about the reporting lag, which matters for point-in-time discipline.
themes: 13F holdings parsers and institutional-ownership history, short-interest datasets, insider-transaction parsers (Form 4), ETF holdings trackers
why_all: Illustrates the quarter-over-quarter diff mechanics for a single filer's 13F holdings (useful pattern for building an ABNB-holder concentration/turnover series) and is refreshingly explicit about the reporting lag, which matters for point-in-time discipline.

name: thirteen-f-scrape
what_it_holds: SEC EDGAR 13F filings scraper plus a Dagster/DuckDB/Evidence data-pipeline and dashboard stack. Updated 2026-04-09, no license listed.
why_useful: A more production-grade (orchestrated, DuckDB-backed) 13F pipeline than the ad-hoc scrapers -- fits our DuckDB-centric workflow if we wanted to stand up an ongoing 13F pull rather than a one-off script.
themes: 13F holdings parsers and institutional-ownership history, short-interest datasets, insider-transaction parsers (Form 4), ETF holdings trackers
